articles.summary: With two service dogs already changing veterans’ lives, the organizations welcome a third puppy on her journey toward a lifetime of service. America’s VetDogs , a New York-based national nonprofit that provides specially trained service dogs to veterans, first responders, and active-duty service members with disabilities, alongside American Integrity Insurance Group, Inc., a Tampa-based property and casualty insurance holding company, today announced they will co-raise a future service dog for a United States veteran or first responder with disabilities. The American Integrity pup is an energetic 3-month-old, female yellow Labrador Retriever. Her name will be announced tomorrow at American Integrity’s annual Gratitude Gathering event, where American Integrity employees will meet her for the first time. articles.title: Three Puppies. One Powerful Purpose: American Integrity and America’s VetDogs Continue Their Life-Changing Partnership
